list.empty: No quote matches the current filter.

open.title: Open quote
open.description: Opens a quote document in the content area and keeps it as a tab.
open.answers: The number of the quote that was opened.

arg.number: The quote number, for example Q-0007.

send.title: Send quote to customer
send.description: Sends a quote to its customer and marks it as sent. This is a consequential step: the customer sees it.
send.answers: The quote's number and its new status.

arg.number: The quote number, for example Q-0007.

margin.title: Read a quote's margin
margin.description: Answers the revenue, cost and margin of a quote. Only accounting may see margins.
margin.answers: The quote's revenue, cost and margin.

arg.number: The quote number, for example Q-0007.

create.title: New quote
create.noMatch: No customer found under that name.
create.description: Creates a quote for a customer and opens it.
create.answers: Whether a quote was created and which id it was given.

arg.customer: Part of the name of the customer the quote is for.
